tools.name: search_repositories
tools.description: Search public GitHub repositories. Use this to find projects by keywords, language, or star count. Returns a short list with name, description, stars, language, and URL.

tools.name: get_repository
tools.description: Get one public GitHub repository by owner and name. Use this when the repository is already known. Returns stars, forks, license, default branch, topics, and URL. open_issues_count includes pull requests.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List recent releases for a public GitHub repository. Use this for tags and publish dates. Release note bodies are omitted.

tools.name: list_open_issues
tools.description: List open issues for a public GitHub repository. Pull requests are omitted. Use this for current issues, not code or releases.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a public GitHub user or organization profile by login. Returns name, bio, company, location, follower counts, and URL.

tools.name: get_readme
tools.description: Fetch a public repository README, truncated to a short excerpt. Use this for the maintainer's project overview.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_repositories, get_repository, list_open_issues, get_user_profile · Public sink: list_releases.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_repositories, get_repository, list_open_issues, get_user_profile · Public sink: list_releases

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
